svg.text: Before: the grid covers the space
spaceSize / R per cell, counted from world zero
64 points in 26 of 256 cells — up to 12 in one
Now: the grid covers the data
extent / R per cell, counted from the data origin
64 points in 55 of 256 cells — up to 3 in one
data box: the live points’ bounding square
The box, every tick, on the GPU
three passes, never read back to the CPU
Anchored to the space, a layout spanning a fraction f of each axis gets (f·R)² of the R² cells — 0.25/f² points per cell, not ≤ 0.25.
Fitted to the data, the average occupancy over the box depends on the point count alone, wherever the layout sits and whatever its size.
